newsitem.title: UK: Burmah drops as Hoare Govett downgrades.
newsitem.headline: Burmah drops as Hoare Govett downgrades.

text.p: Shares in Burmah Castrol Plc dropped in a weak oil sector as analysts at ABN AMRO Hoare Govett cut the lubricants company to "hold" from "undervalued", market sources said.
The stock was down 11-1/2p at 11.12-1/2 by 0836 GMT.
Burmah shares have come under pressure since reaching a record 11.79 stg on October 4, having risen sharply from below 970p at the end of July.
Market sources said the Hoare Govett downgrade was due to valuation considerations but further details were not immediately available.
Elsewhere in the oil sector Shell Transport & Trading Co was down 9p at 10.19 stg, BP was down 7p at 681-1/2 and Enterprise Oil was down 5p at 563-1/2.
Traders said the sector was subject to a second day of profit-taking and U.S. selling after its recent strong run.
